description: This source file defines a ServiceLogging class used for monitoring and logging service health and call metrics in a system, with support for multiple external logging integrations such as Prometheus, Datadog, and OpenTelemetry. It includes methods for handling successful and failed service calls, initializing external loggers, and tracking call latency.
